description: This file defines a class `ConfigFileWatcher` that monitors changes to a specific configuration file or its containing directory using a file watcher mechanism.

classes.name: ConfigFileWatcher
classes.description: A class that watches a specific configuration file for changes and triggers a callback when modifications are detected.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a ConfigFileWatcher instance with a URL and a callback to execute upon file change detection.
